title: Free Claude Code runs AI models from OpenAI, Google, NVIDIA with one #AItools #Coding #OpenSource
description: Claude Code is a versatile tool that allows users to access multiple AI models from providers like OpenAI, Google, and NVIDIA without needing to install additional software such as Alarma. The process involves installing an anti-gravity extension, using a specific setup prompt, and integrating an API key—ideally through OpenRouter, which consolidates access to various AI services in one platform. This approach works effectively by offering flexibility for different tasks such as coding, reasoning, and research, enabling users to switch between models seamlessly. Running everything directly from the terminal enhances convenience and efficiency, appealing to developers and tech-savvy users seeking streamlined AI integration without heavy software installations. The core value lies in simplifying AI access and broadening model options, which is especially beneficial for users who prefer command-line interfaces or want an all-in-one solution. #ClaudeCode #AItools #OpenRouter #ArtificialIntelligence #CodingAI #MachineLearning #AIIntegration #TerminalTools #API #OpenAI #GoogleAI #NVIDIA #DeveloperTools #TechInnovation #ProductivityTools
